verdict.reason: The repeated constraint failure teaches a new delivery habit, reconciling a writing function with its table constraint and verifying locally before a repeat push, which the knowledge does not yet hold.

lessons.text: When a database function writes into a table with a shape constraint, check every kind of work the function accepts against that constraint, and run the database checks locally before pushing a fix.
